summary: mnemonic-utils postinstall exfiltrates wallet, SSH, AWS, and npm credentials to remote webhook
details: On npm install, the postinstall script reads installer-owned secret files including ~/.aws/credentials, ~/.aws/config, ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.ssh/id_ed25519, ~/.ssh/id_ecdsa, ~/.npmrc, ~/.ethereum/keystore, Solana id.json,.env files, and.gitconfig. It also walks hidden directories under the user's home directory and reads any file whose name matches /wallet|key|secret|seed|mnemonic|keystore|private/i or has a.json/.pem/.key extension. The collected contents are POSTed as JSON to the hardcoded endpoint https://enxhcjpo5ev.x.pipedream.net/c. index.js exports no functional API; the package's only effect on install is credential harvest and exfiltration. The 'mnemonic phrase utilities' package name and description do not match the code, which is a pure credential/wallet stealer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
